objective.statement: Compose a council FROM the task: select the roles, the protocol, the voting method and the stopping rule from the question itself, publish the reason for every choice, and let the owner override any of them before the first round.
objective.charter: The default council when no preset fits. Three obligations make it safe rather than magical. (1) It selects: seat count, roles, protocol stages, voting method and topology are derived from the task's risk tier, its decision type and the expertise it needs. (2) It EXPLAINS: every selection is published with the property of the task that drove it, so a wrong composition is visible before it costs a round. (3) It YIELDS: the owner may replace any selection, and an override is recorded as a composition decision, not as a failure. An auto-composed council that cannot show its reasoning is a black box wearing a roster.
success_criteria: a composition rationale exists with one line per selected seat, stage, and rule, each naming the task property that drove it
the owner override channel is offered BEFORE the first substantive round, not after
the seat count and roles actually used match the published composition, or the divergence is recorded
divergence precedes convergence: no synthesis stage runs before independent positions exist
the stopping rule it selected is stated in the same executable grammar as any hand-written preset

custom_protocol.name: auto-composition
custom_protocol.description: Stage 'compose' derives the roster, the stage list, the voting method and the stopping rule from the task's risk tier, decision type and required expertise, and writes one rationale line per selection. Stage 'override' presents that composition to the owner and applies any replacement before a single substantive round is spent. Both stages are cheap and both are auditable; neither expresses an opinion on the question.

all_of.producer: stage 'compose': a rationale artifact exists with one line per selected seat, stage and rule, each naming the task property that drove it, and stage 'override' recorded either an owner edit or an explicit no-change
all_of.note: This leaf is what stops the auto-composer from being a black box: the council may not terminate unless its own composition was explained and offered for override.
Divergence then convergence. The compose and override stages do not count as deliberation rounds.

any_of.note: Default agreement threshold; the composer may raise it for a high or critical risk tier.
A demonstration that the question cannot be answered as scoped is a terminal success, not a failure to decide.

conditional_decision_requires: any condition the council attached is closed and re-checked by the seat that raised it

metadata.title: C-G73 general-purpose auto-composed council
metadata.notes: HUMAN-STOP: custom:composition_rationale_published == true AND rounds_elapsed >= 2 AND (consensus >= 0.75 OR proof_of_impossibility == true) | LANE-1 ADDITION, NOT A DOC-12 DESIGN ROW: the spec's required-preset list names a general-purpose AUTO-COMPOSED council, but the doc-12 preset index (72 rows, C-M01..C-H72) contains no such row, so no lane's index range (1-16, 17-32, 33-48, 49-64) would have produced it and the required list would have shipped one member short. It is numbered 73 to mark it as an addition BEYOND the 72 designs, not a renumbering of them. If a sibling lane also built one, keep whichever is better and delete the other - a duplicate is cheap to reconcile, a missing required preset is a spec violation. | EDITABLE-DIALS: participants.count.min/max and count.elastic.scale_on (how far it may grow) . participants.role_templates (the candidate pool it selects from) . voting.method and consensus.threshold (what the composer is allowed to pick) . the 0.75 in the consensus leaf | NO-ROSTER BY DESIGN: selection.mode=automatic with NO pinned roster - SEM-004 warns when a roster is pinned under automatic selection, and SEM-006 has no ids to check, which is why topology is flat: a chair field would be a dangling participant reference before composition runs | NO-SOURCE-EXPRESSION: the custom leaf carries producer + note, which SEM-001 exact-equality forbids alongside source_expression; the HUMAN-STOP line is proven equivalent by _probe_lane1_presets.py | SEM-009: the proof_of_impossibility leaf forces that outcome into outcomes.allowed | OWNER OVERRIDE: the override window is a PROTOCOL STAGE, not a courtesy - it runs before any deliberation round, and the stopping rule cannot be satisfied until it recorded an edit or an explicit no-change | BINDING: advisory.
